column1: # January 2023 permit report, transcribed from a scan. See README.md.
# This file bundles TWO reports, which is why it is four pages long:
#   pages 1-2  "PERMITS ISSUED BY TYPE" filtered to ELECTRICAL (RESIDENTIAL),
#              ending "GRAND TOTAL OF PERMITS: 2". Its own footer reads
#              "Page 2 of 2", which is easy to mistake for the end of the file.
#   pages 3-4  "Permit Report" for the same month, ending "Total Records: 21".
# The rows below are the Permit Report, because that is the whole month and
# the same format and numbering every other 2023 month uses. The two electrical
# rows on pages 1-2 are deliberately excluded: they are one permit
# (ELER-001508-2021) listed once per associated party, carry a different
# numbering scheme, and appear nowhere in the Permit Report's list — counting
# them alongside it would mix two systems. January 2023 is the transition month
# between the two formats, which is why both are present at all.
# Layout: "Permit Report" — no valuation column, so every value is empty.
# Permits run 25 down to 5 with no gaps: 11 rows on page 3, 10 on page 4.
# Addresses on page 4 repeat the street type and number ("5628 CHINOOK COURT
# CT 5628"); that is how the city printed them and it is kept verbatim.
